# AuraEvents

> AuraEvents is an event-planning web app for exploring event services, estimating budgets, and managing booking inquiries. It supports local demo data and can optionally connect to Supabase.

## Main sections

- [Home](/)
- [Cost calculator](/#calculator): Estimate event costs by event type and guest count.
- [Services](/#services): Browse event infrastructure, equipment, and planning services.
- [Pricing plans](/#pricing): Compare the Seminar Basic, Cultural Fest Pro, and Mega Arena Elite plans.
- [Database dashboard](/#db-console): Review database and transaction features.
- [Event showcases](/#showcase): Explore example event models.
- [Frequently asked questions](/#faq)
- [Contact and inquiries](/#contact)

## Important information

- Sign-in and checkout are demonstrations only. No real payment provider is connected.
- Without Supabase configuration, demo data is stored in the browser using local storage.
- Email notifications require a separately configured backend and SMTP credentials.
- Do not submit real payment details or expose private credentials in frontend configuration.
